intent: Compare England's annual net housing additions across fiscal years 2000-01 to 2018-19 against the annual target and identify the highest year.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
How do England's annual net housing additions change from 2000-01 to 2018-19?
Does the video identify the highest year for England's annual net housing additions?

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: England's annual net housing additions fluctuate over fiscal years 2000-01 to 2018-19 but rise overall from 132.00 thousand in 2000-01 to 247.77 thousand in 2018-19.
units.computation: Compare the first and last plotted values: 247.77 - 132.00 = 115.77 thousand, an overall increase, while the intervening path is not monotonic.
accept: Net housing additions rise overall from 132.00 thousand in 2000-01 to 247.77 thousand in 2018-19.
The path is described as fluctuating rather than monotonically increasing.
reject: Claims that additions are flat across the period.

units.claim: The highest annual net housing additions occur in fiscal year 2018-19 with 247.77 thousand homes.
units.computation: Identify the maximum value among all net housing additions data points; the maximum is 247.77 at 2018-19.
accept: The video explicitly identifies 2018-19 as the year with the highest net housing additions.
The chart highlights or annotates the peak at 2018-19.
reject: The video identifies a different year as the highest.
The video does not identify any highest year.

optional_valid: The video may show the overall upward trend from 2000-01 to 2018-19.
The video may mention the minimum value in 2012-13 (130.61 thousand homes).
Comparing net housing additions with the annual target is optional_valid for V1 because the target series/value is absent from data_table.csv; it must not count as a required unit.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for changes in net housing additions.
Comparisons with other countries or regions not present in the table.
Exact values for years not explicitly listed in the table summary.
Do not claim that additions met or exceeded an annual target: the supplied data_table.csv contains no target series or target value.
review_notes: The annual target value is not provided in the table summary; the comparison unit assumes the target is visualized as a reference line, but the exact target value is unknown from the given data.
Only three x-axis anchors are explicitly labeled in the summary; intermediate years are represented by point_order only.
Closure truth correction 2026-10-29: claims, ranges, computations, and relations were checked against data_table.csv.
Closure adjudication 2026-10-29: data_table.csv is authoritative; unlabeled plotted turns are retained when they belong to the series.
